name: pythia160-probe-2of3-lr1e-3
desc: pythia160 LR probe rung 2of3 (lr 1e-3). Shape = Pythia-160M (12L x 768 x 12H, 162.7M @ 50k untied, our stack) - the top rung of the capacity series 70.65M -> 113.86M -> 162.6M. Rungs [5e-4, 1e-3, 1.5e-3] centered below the 50k winner at 70M (W=1.5e-3 scaled down for width 512->768; 2W=3e-3 diverged at 70M so it is a known dead zone). 1000 steps/rung, eff batch 64, pick = min val bpb at step 1000 across the three rungs, then arm the pythia160 long run by hand.
notes: Micro-batch 8 x accum 8 = eff 64 (NOT 16x4 like the pythia-50k ladder): measured 2026-09-22, pythia160 fwd+bwd+AdamW peaks 13,879 MiB at micro-batch 16 on the 16,376 MiB 4070 Ti (OOM-adjacent once llama-server reloads), 7,268 MiB at micro-batch 8. Eff batch is the control variable so the LR still transfers. No patience args on purpose: clean 1000-step rungs like the 50k ladder probes. NOTE match '--lr 1e-3' cannot collide with rung 3of3 ('--lr 1.5e-3').
